title: Wi-Tek WI-ER205 Cloud Managed Gigabit Router and AP Controller

items.h: AP Management: Up to 32 Access Points

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Wi-Tek WI-ER205 is a reliable cloud-managed gigabit router and wireless AP controller designed for small to medium business networks. It features 5 Gigabit Ethernet ports including 1 WAN, 3 WAN/LAN, and 1 LAN, providing flexible network configuration and high-speed connectivity.


This router supports centralized management of up to 32 Wi-Tek access points, allowing administrators to monitor and control the entire wireless network from a single cloud platform. With SD-LAN support and cloud management, the WI-ER205 simplifies network deployment, maintenance, and remote management.


It is ideal for offices, hotels, retail stores, and enterprise environments that require stable internet connectivity and centralized wireless control.


Key Features


  • 5 Gigabit Ethernet Ports (1× WAN + 3× WAN/LAN + 1× LAN)
  • Cloud-managed router and gateway
  • Supports up to 32 AP cloud controller
  • Centralized management for Wi-Tek access points
  • SD-LAN support for intelligent networking
  • Secure and stable network performance
  • Ideal for business and enterprise networks
